Download PacketEvents for your platform (Spigot/Paper build) and copy it into plugins/ . Copy OmniGuard-x.y.z.jar into plugins/ . Start the server. You should see OmniGuard x.y.z enabled on Paper in … ms . Run /og doctor in game or in the console. Never install or update OmniGuard with /reload or plugin managers. Netty handlers must be injected while the server starts. Bedrock players (Geyser / Floodgate) Fully supported. Floodgate name prefixes ( . and * by default, see login-guard.bedrock-prefixes ) are accepted, Geyser's local connections are never rate-limited, and Geyser-translated inventory clicks are not judged by Java-only rules. Behind a proxy (BungeeCord / Velocity) checks.connection-flood.behind-proxy: auto detects forwarding (spigot.yml bungeecord , Paper Velocity settings). In proxy mode, per-IP connection limits switch off because all traffic comes from the proxy. Every other protection keeps working, including per-IP login limits, which use the forwarded player IP. Updating Replace the jar and restart. New config keys fall back to their defaults until you add them. /og reload lists anything it had to fall back on. Configuration Everything lives in plugins/OmniGuard/config.yml . OmniGuard never rewrites this file; in-game changes go to state.yml . How a check decides Every detection adds to the player's violation level (VL) for that check. The VL cools down by decay-per-second . checks : book : enabled : true # run the check at all cancel : true # drop the packet / action (false = observe only) alert-vl : 1 # alert staff from this VL on max-vl : 2 # punish at this VL decay-per-second : 0.02 kick : true # kick at max-vl instant-kick : true # kick immediately for payloads only a crash client can send commands : [] # console commands run at max-vl Placeholders for commands : %player% %uuid% %ip% %check% %vl% %detail% . %detail% is cleaned of anything that could inject arguments. commands : - "litebans:tempban %player% 1d Crash attempt (%check%)" Rate syntax Rates are written as "<per second>/s burst <burst>" , e.g. "60/s burst 200" . "40/120" and "40/s" also work (the burst defaults to twice the rate). Safety nets Typos never disable protection. A wrong value is replaced by the default and reported in the console and by /og reload . Monitor mode ( monitor-mode: true or /og monitor on ): everything is detected and alerted, nothing is blocked. Bypass : omniguard.bypass (everything) or omniguard.bypass.<check-id> . Packet firewall Runs on Netty event loops through a PacketEvents listener. Nothing here touches the world, so it is lock-free and Folia-safe. Layers Frame guard ( frame-guard ): a Netty handler right after Minecraft's frame splitter. It counts frames and bytes per connection, separately for pre-play (handshake/status/login) and play. A flood is cut off before any packet is decoded , and the IP is blocked for connection-flood.block-seconds . Connection flood ( connection-flood ): connections (including server-list pings) per IP. Rate ( packet-rate ): a token bucket per packet type plus a global bucket per player. Size ( packet-size ): decoded body size per packet type. Content checks : decode the packet and validate it. Check Examples of what is refused invalid-movement NaN/∞ coordinates, outside ±30 000 000, impossible pitch, >160 blocks in one packet without a teleport book >100 pages, >1024 chars/page, books larger than any vanilla book can be, impossible slots. Long books in any language are fine; book bans built from many books are stopped by chunk-ban sign , anvil , chat Over-long text, control characters, formatting-code injection window-click Mode/button combinations no client produces, slots out of range, >128 changed slots creative Creative packets outside creative, >64 KB items, stack >99 tab-complete , command Nested selector bombs, WorldEdit //calc , Multiverse ReDoS, HolographicDisplays path traversal (regex list; operators exempt from the list) plugin-message Long channel names, >128 registered channels, legacy exploit channels invalid-slot Hotbar slot ∉ 0–8, bundle/pick indexes out of range interact Self-attack, impossible interaction points, digging/placing far from the player (forced chunk loads) admin-packet Command/structure/jigsaw/test blocks, game rules or difficulty from non-ops malformed-packet Anything that cannot be decoded is always dropped Teleport awareness Movement and distance checks follow the server's teleports (including relative ones), so ender pearls, /tp , respawns and world changes never produce false positives.

Item Ledger & anti-dupe How the ledger works Identity. Valuable unstackable items (elytra, totems, tridents, maces, netherite gear, and every enchanted unstackable item by default) get a random UUID in their persistent data. Players cannot see it, and stacking is unaffected. Sightings. Online inventories, ender chests, cursors and the contents of shulkers and bundles are scanned in the background, spread over scan-interval-seconds . Containers are scanned when opened and closed. Detection. The same identity twice in one holder is a certain dupe. The same identity in two holders within the window is checked again on each holder's own thread. On Folia this happens twice, one second apart, so an item that is simply being moved never counts as a dupe. Action. ALERT (default) or REMOVE_COPY (confiscates the copy that showed up last). Chain of custody Each identity remembers its last custody-depth holders. Dupe alerts (in game, log file and Discord) include the chain, e.g. player Steve → chest world 10 64 -3 → player Alex . Use /og ledger trace to look at any item. Creative and kits Items handled by creative-mode players get a fresh identity, so creative cloning is never reported. Kit and crate plugins that saved one tracked item hand out identical copies. When the same identity is confirmed in template-threshold (3) different holders, OmniGuard treats it as a template: it stops alerting and tells you once. /og ledger unignore <uid> reverses that, and /og ledger ignore <uid> does it by hand. Gain monitor For stackable valuables ( gain-monitor.thresholds ), OmniGuard compares inventory + ender chest + shulker contents over a window, minus gains that a legitimate source explains: pickups, crafting, furnaces, trades and container withdrawals. It is alert-only. Known dupe patches ( dupe-patches ) Inventory entities (chest donkeys, llamas, chest minecarts and boats) cannot go through portals while loaded. Inventories close safely on quit, world change, owner death, vehicle break, block break/explosion and chunk unload. No inventory actions while dead. Drop-spam rate limit. Illegal items ( illegal-items ) Survival items with enchantments above max-enchant-level (30), stacks larger than allowed, or (optionally) unbreakable flags are reported on join, inventory close, container open and pickup. The check is alert-only by default ( fix: false ). Items made by plugins (custom name, lore, model data or another plugin's data) are skipped, so nothing a server sells is ever changed without the owner deciding so.

World shield All limits are per chunk and per second, and thread-safe for Folia. When TPS falls below world-shield.low-tps-threshold , every limit is multiplied by low-tps-multiplier . Check Default Action redstone 900 updates/chunk/s Freeze redstone in the chunk for 10 s ( action: BREAK also breaks the trigger) piston 120 moves/chunk/s Freeze pistons for 10 s hopper 800 item moves/chunk/s Freeze hoppers for 5 s explosion 40 primes/chunk/s Cancel extra explosions entity-cap items 600, xp 200, vehicles 48, armor stands 48, falling blocks 120, projectiles 160, TNT 80, mobs 120, hanging 64 Cancel new spawns chunk-ban container / player inventory 2 MB, item 400 KB, lectern book 120 KB (uncompressed sizes, checked on every insertion and book edit) Refuse the insertion chunk-gen 120 new chunks/s server-wide while TPS is low Pause elytra firework boosts for 15 s /og lag lists the heaviest loaded chunks to help you find the source.

Connection shield Built for shared IPs One IP is very often many real people: a family, a school, an internet café, or a mobile carrier that puts thousands of customers behind one address (CGNAT). OmniGuard therefore follows four rules: Trusted IPs. Once a real player completes a join from an IP, that IP is trusted. It gets trusted-multiplier (5×) more connections and logins, it is never blocked, and attack mode never tightens it. Refuse, do not block. Connections above the limit are refused one by one. A whole IP is blocked only after block-after-refusals (40) refusals within 10 seconds, which only a flood produces. No account caps on trusted IPs. max-accounts-per-ip is 0 (off) by default. During attack mode, attack-max-accounts-per-ip applies to untrusted IPs only. Never limit what is not a person. Unknown addresses and 127.0.0.1 / ::1 (Geyser, local proxies) are never limited. This behaviour is covered by the test suite. For example, 10 players on one IP refresh the server list and join together, and all of them get in without a single alert. Check What it does connection-flood Per-IP connections at the Netty level; floods are blocked for 60 s login-guard Username pattern (offline-mode servers only, Bedrock prefixes allowed), per-IP login rate, accounts per IP during attacks, rejoin cycling (8 completed joins/60 s per account) alt-link Links accounts that share IPs and alerts when a new account joins from an IP that a banned account used Attack mode When connections/s, logins/s or blocked packets/s stay above attack-mode thresholds for trigger-seconds , OmniGuard: multiplies connection and login limits by limit-multiplier ; asks unknown IPs to reconnect once (between reconnect-min-seconds and reconnect-max-seconds ). Real players pass, bots usually do not. IPs that joined before are never asked; groups refusal alerts into a single summary when the attack ends ( Attack mode ended after 32s, refused N connections and M logins ). Force it with /og attackmode on|off|auto . Lockdown /og lockdown on lets only already-verified IPs in. Use it while dealing with a raid or a grief wave. The setting is saved in state.yml and survives restarts. Ban evasion /og alts <player> shows every linked account; punished ones are red. Only new accounts (never seen before) on an IP that a currently banned account used are flagged. Siblings who have played for months, and accounts that were only kicked, are not evaders. alt-link.block-evasion: true also refuses such logins. It is off by default because families and schools share IPs.

Server hardening Privilege guard ( privilege-guard ) privilege-guard : trusted-operators : [ YourName , 069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5 ] enforce-creative : true Anyone with OP who is not listed is de-opped within seconds and alerted on. With enforce-creative: true , untrusted players are also kept out of creative and spectator unless they have omniguard.creative . It is off by default because creative and plot servers need creative mode. This stops the classic backdoor plugin ( /op through a hidden command) and stolen staff accounts. While the list is empty the guard does nothing. Fingerprint guard ( fingerprint ) Hides /plugins , /version , /? , /bukkit , /paper , /timings … and the server's own namespaces ( /minecraft:… , /bukkit:… , /spigot:… , /paper:… ) from players. The commands are also removed from tab-completion. Plugin namespaces stay usable, because many plugins use them in clickable chat buttons. Exploit kits use this information to pick an exploit. /og doctor Audits your setup and rates each finding CRIT / WARN / INFO: online-mode=false without a proxy BungeeCord forwarding (needs a firewall) and RCON with a weak password Query enabled, command blocks enabled Operators not in trusted-operators Monitor mode on, packet layer failed, Discord alerts off

Auto-Tune & forensics Auto-Tune Default packet limits are deliberately generous. Auto-Tune measures what your players actually send: It records packets per second, per packet type and per player. Only players who were never flagged on that connection contribute, so attackers cannot teach it to be lax. After auto-tune.min-samples player-seconds (3600 ≈ one player for an hour), /og tune recommends rate = 1.5 × p99.9 and burst ≥ 2 × rate . A recommendation is never below min-rate , and never below 25 % of the default. /og tune apply stores the limits in state.yml , where they override packet-rate.limits . /og tune reset undoes it. [OmniGuard] Learned from 41 233 clean player-seconds since 3h 12m ago: - PLAYER_POSITION_AND_ROTATION p99.9 21/s max 26/s | now 80/s burst 300 → 32/s burst 75 - CLICK_WINDOW p99.9 18/s max 140/s | now 60/s burst 400 → 27/s burst 210 Packet forensics When a player is punished, forensics/<date>/<player>-<time>.txt is written: OmniGuard incident report player : Atk1 client : 1.21.11 / vanilla check : book detail : book too large (122880 > 120000 bytes) Last 4 packets (oldest first, ms relative to the last one): -456.4 ms TELEPORT_CONFIRM 1 B -456.0 ms PLAYER_POSITION_AND_ROTATION 33 B -455.7 ms PLAYER_LOADED 0 B 0.0 ms EDIT_BOOK 307403 B BLOCKED Use these files to answer ban appeals in a minute.

Developer API OmniGuard exposes a typed service in Bukkit's ServicesManager , plus Bukkit events. A complete, compiling example plugin is in examples/api-example . Setup Add the OmniGuard jar to your compile classpath (scope provided / compileOnly ) and declare the dependency: # plugin.yml depend : [ OmniGuard ] # or softdepend OmniGuardService og = Bukkit . getServicesManager (). load ( OmniGuardService . class ); if ( og == null ) { // OmniGuard not installed } Only use classes in dev.omniguard.api and dev.omniguard.api.event . Everything else is internal and may change. OmniGuardService Method Description version() Plugin version isAttackMode() / setAttackMode("auto"\|"on"\|"off") Attack mode isMonitorMode() Detect-only mode isLockdown() / setLockdown(boolean) Lockdown stats() StatsSnapshot(packets, blocked, kicks, refusedConnections, dupes, packetsPerSecond, blockedPerSecond, trackedItems) checks() Map of check id → enabled getViolationLevel(uuid, checkId) / getViolations(uuid) Current violation levels exempt(uuid, checkId, Duration) Temporary exemption from one check, or "*" for all clearExemptions(uuid) / isExempt(uuid, checkId) Manage exemptions reportViolation(player, source, detail, amount) Feed your own detections into OmniGuard's alerts, Discord, logs and the external check's punishments getLinkedAccounts(name) Accounts that shared an IP getItemIdentity(item) Ledger identity of an item trackItem(item) Give an item an identity now (e.g. crate rewards); call on the item's owning thread getCustody(uuid) Chain of custody ( CustodyStep(timeMillis, holder) ) isCompromised(uuid) Whether the identity was confirmed duplicated All methods are thread-safe except trackItem . Unknown check ids throw IllegalArgumentException . Examples Exempt a player during your launch pad og . exempt ( player . getUniqueId (), "invalid-movement" , Duration . ofSeconds ( 5 )); player . setVelocity ( new Vector ( 0 , 3 , 8 )); Report your own detection og . reportViolation ( player , "MyAntiCheat" , "reach 6.2 blocks" , 1.0 ); Track crate rewards ItemStack reward = new ItemStack ( Material . NETHERITE_SWORD ); UUID id = og . trackItem ( reward ); player . getInventory (). addItem ( reward ); Events Event Cancellable When OmniGuardViolationEvent yes (suppresses alert and punishment) Every failed check OmniGuardPunishEvent yes (handle punishment yourself) Right before a kick or punishment commands OmniGuardDupeEvent yes (no confiscation, no alert) A duplicate is confirmed OmniGuardAttackModeEvent no Attack mode starts or stops Violation and punish events may be asynchronous because packet checks run on Netty threads. Use the scheduler before touching the world. Cancelling never lets the malicious packet through. @EventHandler public void onPunish ( OmniGuardPunishEvent e ) { if ( e . getCheckId (). equals ( "packet-rate" )) { e . setCancelled ( true ); // no kick from OmniGuard… jail . send ( e . getPlayerId (), e . getDetail ()); // …your own handling } } Static helper OmniGuardAPI (static) still exists for quick reads: isAttackMode() , getViolationLevel(...) , getBlockedCount(...) , getItemIdentity(...) , and service() , which returns the full OmniGuardService .

FAQ & troubleshooting Does it replace my anticheat? No. OmniGuard protects the server (crashes, dupes, lag, floods, takeovers). Run it next to an anticheat. Anticheats can feed their detections into OmniGuard with reportViolation . A legitimate player was flagged. Run /og inspect <player> and look at forensics/ if they were kicked. Raise that check's limit, or switch it to cancel: true , kick: false while you investigate. For packet rates, let Auto-Tune learn your real traffic. Players with inventory mods (Item Scroller, mouse tweaks) get click-rate alerts. Raise packet-rate.limits.CLICK_WINDOW (the burst matters most), e.g. "80/s burst 800" . Kits trigger dupe alerts. The kit hands out copies of one saved, tracked item. After 3 different holders OmniGuard recognises it as a template and goes quiet. You can also run /og ledger ignore <uid> (the uid is shown in the alert). Ten people play from one house / a school / an internet café. Supported by design: see Built for shared IPs . Nobody is limited for sharing an IP. Bedrock players (Geyser/Floodgate)? Supported: prefixed names are accepted and translated inputs are not judged by Java-only rules. "PacketEvents" is missing at startup. OmniGuard needs the free PacketEvents plugin. Put both jars in plugins/ and restart. I run BungeeCord/Velocity. Leave behind-proxy: auto . Per-IP connection limits switch off; the proxy should run its own antibot. Alerts look garbled in the console. They are ASCII-safe since 1.0.0. Check your console's charset if colors leak. Folia? Fully supported: all world work goes through region and entity schedulers. /og lag is unavailable because Folia has no global chunk view. Performance? Packet checks are lock-free and only decode packets of the types that are checked. World checks are O(1) per event, and ledger scans are spread over time. Profile with /spark on your own server if you need numbers.
